Bearer credentials belong in the Authorization header. Reject secrets embedded in query parameters or user-visible links.

A browser refresh restores the selected repository without replaying a model request. A tab access cookie remains scoped to its local service.
A human approval is bound to the exact plan fingerprint. A changed patch requires a new decision before editing files.

Unknown consumption keeps the originally reserved request allowance held. A restart must not clear the quota or replay the interrupted request.
Compaction retains recent complete tool-call and tool-result pairs. Preserve the original Native message tree and meter the summary call.

An observed Git SHA is not a completed health check. Only a complete authorized test attempt advances the inspected commit cursor.
A database transaction uses compare-and-swap before accepting a candidate version. Concurrent reviews must not overwrite the previous decision.
src/cache/ExpiryClock.py contains ExpiryClock. Its expiration boundary is measured against a monotonic timer.
The src/parser/loadConfig.py symbol loadConfig rejects malformed TOML before installing the provider.
FileNotFoundError is the named exception in file_loader.py. Preserve its type instead of returning an empty value.
HTTPRetryPolicy applies bounded exponential backoff. RetryBudget counts attempts before the next network operation.

HTML output escapes untrusted text through textContent. Render historical instructions as data rather than executable markup.
A supersedes_claim links a newer document to an older document. Keep both original classifications until a human resolves the actual rule.
pytest collection failed before any test body ran. Distinguish a missing dependency from a failed candidate regression.
